As a growing lender or indeed as you cope with commercial transactions that demand many loans, we offer sound, smart loan software system that grow with your staff. Forget two-party tools and adopt a new modernistic and efficient loan management solution. Let’s build an intelligent, quicker and more integrated future to your lending process, together. Looking to Learn More? Check out common questions about our secure, scalable Loan Management Software platform. What are the main benefits of using custom Loan Management Software? A custom loan management software brings together the whole process of lending starting with intake of the borrower to servicing within a single platform. It may be employed to reduce manual work, prevent human mistakes and real time monitoring loan performance. Customized loan management solution enhances easier adherence, customer experience, and enables operations, sales and finance departments to operate and work more efficiently ultimately accelerating loan processing cycles. Can Loan Management Software be integrated with other business systems? Yes, there is a possibility of integrating the modern loan software with CRM (customer relationship management), accounting software, and legacy systems. Integration can generally be performed via APIs or middleware tools that make it possible to exchange data securely in both directions. Under such an arrangement, your loan servicing platform could act as the backbone of your lending activities that keep in sync the three most important data; customer, financial, and compliance data. What APIs are used in Loan Management Software integrations? Real-time exchange of data through RESTful APIs is supported by most of the loan processing software. Such APIs provide an interface to obtain the data on the borrowers, information on loans, and documents as well as the status changes. The information can be pushed or pulled into custom or standard fields on the basis of the systems being integrated (like a CRM or ERP) which might or might not be secured by OAuth and will be audited on the basis of log and reported to ascertain compliance. What kind of data can be synced across platforms? Commonly synchronized data cover profile of borrowers, application information, credit data, terms of loans, stage of services and progress of servicing. The data is synchronized with systems installed inside the company that also contain CRM and central financial programs. A properly integrated loan management software will help in uniformity through all processes and reduce loss of delays and errors in the loan process. How is data mapping handled in loan system integrations? Data mapping is described as the practice of making the fields of the loan management solution integrated with outward ones. It needs excellent knowledge of the structure and formats of data and business rules. Regardless of whether you employ a middleware or direct scripting, a high level of collaboration between the technicians and the business teams is advisable to ensure effective field mapping to facilitate clean, compliant, and traceable workflow. Is custom Loan Management Software secure and compliant? Yes, but on condition that they are built and incorporated in the right way. Secure loan servicing automation platforms implantation, use of encryption, multi factor authentication and robust audit trails are a few examples. It is necessary to comply with regulations like GLBA or CFPB operating following their rules and secure data at all the stages of loan actions, which is provided by proper software architecture.
